verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a Real-time API for querying user profile data (mparticle-docs-4) and has an Audiences section in its Platform API reference (mparticle-docs-19), which suggests programmatic audience management. However, the only documented activation flow requires connecting the audience to an output through the dashboard (Data Platform > Setup > Directory, mparticle-docs-x2), so the end-to-end, dashboard-free path is not shown. missing for 10: documented API or MCP path for activating audiences to outputs, evidence of the Audiences API's create and activate operations beyond a title, an official MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven workflow.
